definitions.gloss: rapid advance; remarkable progress; leaping forward
definitions.explanation: Making rapid, impressive progress or advancement. Used for companies, countries, athletes, or any entity that achieves notable growth or success in a short time.

examples.japanese: その{会社|かいしゃ}は{急速|きゅうそく}に{躍進|やくしん}を{遂|と}げた。
{新興国|しんこうこく}が{世界経済|せかいけいざい}で{躍進|やくしん}している。
examples.english: Emerging nations are making rapid progress in the global economy.

examples.japanese: {若手|わかて}{選手|せんしゅ}の{躍進|やくしん}が{目立|めだ}った。
examples.english: The remarkable progress of young players stood out.

notes:
KANJI BREAKDOWN:
・{躍|やく} - leap, jump
・{進|しん} - advance, progress

The compound literally captures the image of "leaping forward" in progress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{躍進|やくしん}する - to make rapid progress
・{躍進|やくしん}を{遂|と}げる - to achieve rapid advancement
・{目覚|めざ}ましい{躍進|やくしん} - remarkable progress
・{経済的|けいざいてき}{躍進|やくしん} - economic leap forward

NUANCE:
{躍進|やくしん} is always positive, implying impressive, noteworthy advancement that exceeds normal expectations.

CONTRASTING TERMS:
・{停滞|ていたい} - stagnation (opposite)
・{衰退|すいたい} - decline (opposite)
・{後退|こうたい} - retreat, regression

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{飛躍|ひやく} - leap, great progress
・{進歩|しんぽ} - progress, advancement
・{発展|はってん} - development
・{成長|せいちょう} - growth

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in news, business, and sports reporting.
